title: Sugar Absorption model not quite complete
symptom: The predicted BG system's carbohydrate absorption model is not accurate for different types of food, as demonstrated by treating a low with 20g of pure dextrose dissolved in water, which absorbed faster than the model predicted.
cause: The model uses a simple linear absorption model that does not account for food composition (fat, protein, fiber) or carbohydrate type, and absorption varies between individuals and days.
evidence_quote: xDrip+ implements the original DIYPS carbohydrate absorption model which is a simple linear absorption model.
